entry.title: New: dsh-layered-memory
entry.summary: Layered memory pipeline for DSH: auto-distills conversations into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile (L0–L3), with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, chat/work family separation, and context injection before each model step. Exact install spec: dsh-layered-memory. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
